requirements.statement: A valid condition-passing LDRD/STRD emits a two-word transaction descriptor at effective_address and effective_address+4, with read/write direction, both STRD source values, and pending Addressing Mode 3 base writeback. This descriptor does not constrain the architecturally unspecified time order of the two accesses.

source_refs.locator: §A4.1.26 LDRD operation/time order; §A4.1.102 STRD operation/time order

requirements.statement: A condition-passing unaligned ARM946E-S LDRD/STRD is reported as UNPREDICTABLE and emits no constrained transaction descriptor; a failed condition performs no access.
